7.1.4.title: What You Download

7.2.1.title: The Hugging Face Ecosystem
7.2.1.alt: The Hugging Face Ecosystem. The Hub and local cache supply compatible artifacts. Tokenizers, Datasets and Transformers serve different stages of the application; cards supply evidence to inspect.
7.2.1.caption: The Hub and local cache supply compatible artifacts. Tokenizers, Datasets and Transformers serve different stages of the application; cards supply evidence to inspect.

7.2.2.title: Anatomy of a Model Repository
7.2.2.alt: Anatomy of a Model Repository. A repository can contain documentation, configuration, weights and tokenizer artifacts in several formats. Download only the compatible files required by your framework.
7.2.2.caption: A repository can contain documentation, configuration, weights and tokenizer artifacts in several formats. Download only the compatible files required by your framework.

7.2.3.title: A Dataset Pipeline
7.2.3.alt: A Dataset Pipeline. Inspect examples, transform them under a declared policy, then dynamically pad and mask each batch. Learned preprocessing must be fitted on training data only.
7.2.3.caption: Inspect examples, transform them under a declared policy, then dynamically pad and mask each batch. Learned preprocessing must be fitted on training data only.

7.2.4.title: From Name to Working Model
7.2.4.alt: From Name to Working Model. The repository name resolves to artifacts; the tokenizer prepares IDs and masks, and compatible model code loads the architecture and weights before inference.
7.2.4.caption: The repository name resolves to artifacts; the tokenizer prepares IDs and masks, and compatible model code loads the architecture and weights before inference.

7.3.1.title: From Problem to Shortlist
7.3.1.alt: From Problem to Shortlist. Requirements narrow a shortlist; documentation and representative evaluation determine whether a candidate actually fits. Popularity and parameter count alone do not decide.
7.3.1.caption: Requirements narrow a shortlist; documentation and representative evaluation determine whether a candidate actually fits. Popularity and parameter count alone do not decide.

7.3.3.title: The Model-Selection Checklist
7.3.3.alt: The Model-Selection Checklist. Check interface, parameter storage versus runtime memory, context, benchmark protocol, training exposure and deployment terms before adopting a model.
7.3.3.caption: Check interface, parameter storage versus runtime memory, context, benchmark protocol, training exposure and deployment terms before adopting a model.

7.4.1.title: From Text to Label in Five Steps
7.4.1.alt: From Text to Label in Five Steps. Tokenization, model computation, logits, probabilities and label mapping are separate steps. Weights stay fixed during this inference flow.
7.4.1.caption: Tokenization, model computation, logits, probabilities and label mapping are separate steps. Weights stay fixed during this inference flow.

7.4.2.title: Padding, Masks and Truncation
7.4.2.alt: Padding, Masks and Truncation. Padding adds positions, an attention mask restricts access to padded positions, and truncation discards input. This illustration is not a causal future-token mask.
7.4.2.caption: Padding adds positions, an attention mask restricts access to padded positions, and truncation discards input. This illustration is not a causal future-token mask.

7.4.3.title: The Inference Checklist
7.4.3.alt: The Inference Checklist. Evaluation mode controls layers such as dropout; no-gradient inference controls autograd. Model and inputs must use compatible devices. Save preprocessing and settings too.
7.4.3.caption: Evaluation mode controls layers such as dropout; no-gradient inference controls autograd. Model and inputs must use compatible devices. Save preprocessing and settings too.

7.5.1.title: From Capability to Feature
7.5.1.alt: From Capability to Feature. An application adds input validation, decision rules, error handling and measured quality to a pretrained capability. The OOD check is a heuristic to validate, not a guarantee.
7.5.1.caption: An application adds input validation, decision rules, error handling and measured quality to a pretrained capability. The OOD check is a heuristic to validate, not a guarantee.

7.5.3.title: Four Capabilities, One Lesson
7.5.3.alt: Four Capabilities, One Lesson. Each capability has failure modes. The notebook measures particular examples; similarity, confidence and fluent generation do not by themselves establish correctness.
7.5.3.caption: Each capability has failure modes. The notebook measures particular examples; similarity, confidence and fluent generation do not by themselves establish correctness.

7.7.2.title: The Model-Selection Workflow
7.7.2.alt: The Model-Selection Workflow. Requirements, documentation, representative inputs, validation choices and final reporting belong in a recorded process. Repeated selection on a test sample requires a new final test.
7.7.2.caption: Requirements, documentation, representative inputs, validation choices and final reporting belong in a recorded process. Repeated selection on a test sample requires a new final test.

8.1.1.title: The Adaptation Spectrum
8.1.1.alt: The Adaptation Spectrum. Prompting changes the input; a frozen encoder supports a trained head; LoRA changes selected adapters; full fine-tuning makes the selected base parameters trainable. More complexity need not improve quality.
8.1.1.caption: Prompting changes the input; a frozen encoder supports a trained head; LoRA changes selected adapters; full fine-tuning makes the selected base parameters trainable. More complexity need not improve quality.

8.1.3.title: Choosing Where to Adapt
8.1.3.alt: Choosing Where to Adapt. Measure simpler options before adding training cost. The order is a decision aid, not a guaranteed quality ranking or a claim that every task requires an LLM prompt.
8.1.3.caption: Measure simpler options before adding training cost. The order is a decision aid, not a guaranteed quality ranking or a claim that every task requires an LLM prompt.

8.2.1.title: The Data Preparation Pipeline
8.2.1.alt: The Data Preparation Pipeline. Group duplicate examples before splitting; keep validation and test out of training updates. Fit learned preprocessing on train, then apply the declared policy to held-out data.
8.2.1.caption: Group duplicate examples before splitting; keep validation and test out of training updates. Fit learned preprocessing on train, then apply the declared policy to held-out data.

8.3.1.title: The Baseline Ladder
8.3.1.alt: The Baseline Ladder. Baselines share a declared evaluation protocol. Off-the-shelf, frozen-feature and trained alternatives use different upstream training and sometimes different input information; disclose those differences.
8.3.1.caption: Baselines share a declared evaluation protocol. Off-the-shelf, frozen-feature and trained alternatives use different upstream training and sometimes different input information; disclose those differences.

8.4.1.title: The Fine-Tuning Loop
8.4.1.alt: The Fine-Tuning Loop. Only training batches drive gradients and optimizer updates. Validation selects checkpoints; a declared final test reports the selected setup.
8.4.1.caption: Only training batches drive gradients and optimizer updates. Validation selects checkpoints; a declared final test reports the selected setup.

8.5.1.title: Full Fine-Tuning vs. LoRA
8.5.1.alt: Full Fine-Tuning vs. LoRA. LoRA adds (alpha/r) BA beside a frozen weight matrix. A starts random and B starts at zero, so the initial adapter update is zero; the task head may also train.
8.5.1.caption: LoRA adds (alpha/r) BA beside a frozen weight matrix. A starts random and B starts at zero, so the initial adapter update is zero; the task head may also train.

8.6.1.title: From Base Model to Assistant
8.6.1.alt: From Base Model to Assistant. This assistant-only SFT setup keeps prompt tokens visible as context while masking their targets from loss. Causal prediction shifts targets by one; LoRA adapts selected parameters.
8.6.1.caption: This assistant-only SFT setup keeps prompt tokens visible as context while masking their targets from loss. Causal prediction shifts targets by one; LoRA adapts selected parameters.

8.7.1.title: Seven Questions Before Keeping a Model
8.7.1.alt: Seven Questions Before Keeping a Model. Evaluation combines training behaviour, held-out metrics, errors, retention, costs, reproducibility and the application decision. A p-value alone does not settle suitability.
8.7.1.caption: Evaluation combines training behaviour, held-out metrics, errors, retention, costs, reproducibility and the application decision. A p-value alone does not settle suitability.
